request.task: What major changes did Tailwind CSS v4.0 introduce?

key_changes: New high‑performance engine built in Rust (Oxide) delivering up to 5× faster full builds and over 100× faster incremental builds
CSS‑first configuration – tailwind.config moves from JavaScript to CSS and design tokens are exposed as native CSS variables
Automatic content detection eliminates the need to manually specify the content array
First‑party Vite plugin for tighter integration and zero‑config setup
Modernized P3 color palette using OKLCH for more vivid colors
Container queries added as core features, removing the need for the external plugin
New 3D transform utilities (rotate‑x‑*, rotate‑y‑*, scale‑z‑*, translate‑z‑* etc.)
Expanded gradient APIs with linear, radial, and conic utilities, angle support, and color‑interpolation modifiers
not‑* variant supporting the CSS :not() pseudo‑class
Additional utilities and variants such as inset‑shadow‑*, inset‑ring‑*, field‑sizing, color‑scheme, font‑stretch, inert, nth‑*, in‑*, and support for :popover‑open
